cells.note:
* Left plat spawn height: 15.05462
* Right plat spawn height: 25.95285

* Platforms shift independently and randomly every 10-18 secs

* Platform heights range between 13.54725 and 27.1237, with 38 possible heights in-between

* Platforms have a 1/8 chance to completely sink

* After sinking, the plat will remain absent for a random period of 8-28 seconds. After this, it will enter the RiseWarning state.

* The RiseWarning state is indicated by a water ripple effect and lasts for 119 frames. During the last 45 frames, if any characters are present near the ripple, the 119-frame timer will restart at the end of the cycle. If no characters are present, the platform will rise instead at the end of the cycle.

* The platform return height is always 20.33288
